landing.headline: See where you stand for the job you want
landing.subhead: Upload your resume. Find out how well you match a job in Canada, what it's likely to pay you, and exactly what would raise your score.
landing.step1Body: Upload a PDF or Word file, and any portfolio links you have.
landing.step2Title: Choose a job and a place
landing.step2Body: Pick a job title and a province, or all of Canada.
landing.step3Body: See your score, likely pay, gaps, a 90-day plan and other roles that fit.
landing.honestTitle: Built to be straight with you
landing.honest1Body: Your score is plain arithmetic. Each category shows its points and why it got them, and they add up to the total.
landing.honest2Title: Your background stays out of it
landing.honest2Body: Your name, contact details and details like age or nationality are taken out before the AI reads your resume, where we can detect them.
landing.honest3Body: Pay comes from job ads on Canada's Job Bank, and the skills come from an official list. AI can make mistakes, so we show the evidence behind each result.
landing.footer: CareerFit gives estimates to help you plan. It doesn't guarantee a job or any salary.
